richiami.difetto: The clutch pedal may detach from the pedal box due to a non-conformity of the pedal pivot shaft.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new pivot shaft and retaining devices.

richiami.difetto: Seizure of vehicle steering box resulting in sudden and unexpected loss of steering control of the vehicle. Issue came to light on the investigation of two customer vehicles which experienced the above symptoms. In both cases LTI Vehicles were able to confirm the symptoms and establish the root cause as a displaced retention circlip within the working mechanism of the steering box.
richiami.rimedio: LTI Vehicles will inform customers of this potential issue and recommend that they stop using their vehicle. A refurbished steering box will be supplied and fitted on all of the affected vehicles as soon as validated parts become available.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the drop arm on the steering idler shaft may become loose due to the loosing of the drop arm retention nut. In extreme conditions the steering operation may become erratic.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the drop arm retention nut to be removed have Loctite high strength thread sealant added to the threads and refitted then torqued to the appropriate setting.
richiami.titolo: STEERING DROP ARM MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the handbrake cable may detach from the handbrake lever due to an issue with the quality of the weld on the cable pivot post and the lever.  In the worst case this could cause a release of the handbrake.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the handbrake lever plus associated components.

richiami.difetto: The battery/alternator positive lead connection has been found insecure in its crimped connector to the starter motor on a small number of vehicles. This could cause prolonged engine cranking/difficulty in starting and if they detached from the starter motor during normal driving the engine would eventually loose power. It could also result in the cable electrically shorting against metalic components in the surrounding area.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to test the cable fixing and where necessary replace the entire positive lead.

Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to 1.  Fit fire retardant shields over the bulkhead sound insulation material 2. Replace the EGR pipes 3. Fit a new EGR heat shield to EGR pipe 4. Check the integrity and fit of all related under bonnet components.

richiami.difetto: Fuel injector pipe to fuel pump may leak.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reposition the supporting clamp.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to an incorrect specification the turbo intake hose may deform due to oil contamination. Should this occur the engine power would be significantly reduced resulting in an attainable road speed of less than 20mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the turbo hose replaced with a quality assured item.

richiami.difetto: The brake disc to hub mount bolts may be loose which could when the brakes are applied cause judder and noisy braking. This could eventually result in the failure of the retaining bolts and ultimately the disc being detached from the hub.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit new bolts with loctite applied and torque the disc to hub fixing bolts to specification.

richiami.difetto: The axle fastner of the rear axle panhard rod may fail. This will initially cause lateral movement of the axle which if ignored may lead to loss of directional control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the axle fastner of the panhard rod.

richiami.difetto: The axle fastner of the rear axle panhard rod may fail. This will initially cause lateral movement of the axle which if ignored may lead to loss of directional control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the axle fastner of the panhard rod.

richiami.difetto: The water pump pulley may shear from it's boss and cause failure of the drive to the brake vacuum and power steering  pumps. This will result in a loss of power assistance to the brakes and steering systems.
richiami.rimedio: Modify the water pump pulley mounting arrangement.
richiami.titolo: WATER PUMP PULLEY MAY SHEAR FROM ITS BOSS

richiami.difetto: As a result of a machining discrepancy the steering box output shaft may fail resulting in loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the steering boxes with quality assured versions.

richiami.difetto: The starter motor terminal may fail causing interruption in the feed to various other electrical circuits. Such a failure would immobilise the vehicle and render the lighting system inoperative.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for modifications to the wiring which will prevent such an interruption from occurring.
